description: This file contains startup classes for configuring services related to OrchardCore modules, specifically for Azure AI Search integration, including feature-specific startup classes for search, content types, contents, recipes, deployment, and flows.

classes.name: Startup
classes.description: Main startup class for Azure AI Search, configuring index profiles, navigation, services, and migrations.

classes.name: SearchStartup
classes.description: Configures search service for Azure AI Search, activated when 'OrchardCore.Search' feature is enabled.

classes.name: ContentTypesStartup
classes.description: Configures content type related services, activated when 'OrchardCore.ContentTypes' feature is enabled.

classes.name: ContentsStartup
classes.description: Configures content indexing and display drivers, activated when 'OrchardCore.Contents' feature is enabled.

classes.name: RecipeStartup
classes.description: Configures recipe execution steps for Azure AI Search index management, activated when 'OrchardCore.Recipes.Core' feature is enabled.

classes.name: DeploymentStartup
classes.description: Configures deployment sources and steps for Azure AI Search, activated when 'OrchardCore.Deployment' feature is enabled.

classes.name: FlowsStartup
classes.description: Configures flow-related services for Azure AI Search, activated when 'OrchardCore.Flows' feature is enabled.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Method used in each startup class to register services into the dependency injection container.
